# Bihar Aur Purnea Maize Market Report — 4 May 2026 (Somwaar)

## Aaj Ki Sabse Badi Khabar: Iran ki Ladai Abhi Bhi Jari Hai — Tel $109, NCDEX ₹92 Upar!

**Kisan bhai, aaj ka din maize ke liye ek mixed-lekin-bullish din hai.** Do badi taakatein aaj baamar mein chal rahi hain:

**Pehli Taaaat (BULLISH — daam badhane wali):**
NCDEX (Delhi ka bada fasal-bazaar jahan aage ka daam tay hota hai) mein makka ka June 2026 ka daam ₹1,992 chal raha hai — Purnea ke aaj ke daam ₹1,900 se poore ₹92 UPAR. 'Strong Buy' signal hai. Iran ki ladai abhi bhi jari hai — Brent tel aaj $109.60 par chal raha hai (+1.32% aur upar). Trump ne 'Project Freedom' ka plan diya Hormuz khol ne ke liye, lekin Iran ne mana kar diya. Tankers par hamle abhi bhi ho rahe hain. Tel mahanga = ethanol ki zaroorat zyada = makka ki demand bahut zyada. CBOT (America ka bazaar) mein bhi makka ka daam ₹480.75 cents par chal raha hai, Strong Buy signal, aur Managed Money walon ke 264,000 net long contracts hain.

**Doosri Taaaat (BEARISH — daam girane wali):**
Bihar mein rabi (sardi ki) makka ki peak arrivals chal rahi hain — April 5 se May 15 tak sabse zyada maal mandi mein aata hai. Bihar mein is baar 41.27% ZYADA fasal aayi hai pichle saal ke mukable. Zyada maal = daam par dabaav. IMD ke mutabik Bihar mein May mein above-normal rainfall hogi aur temperature normal se neeche rahega — isse harvest jaldi nahi hotegi, lekin arrivals pe kuch asar padega.

**Aaj Ka Purnea Daam:**
Purnea (Bihar) mandi mein aaj makka ₹1,900 per quintal (100 kilo) par chal raha hai. 2 din se yahi daam hai — flat. Sarkar ka MSP ₹2,400 hai — ₹500 ka nuksan abhi bhi chal raha hai kisan bhai ko.

**NCDEX ka kya bol raha hai:**
NCDEX (Delhi ka bada fasal-bazaar) mein makka ka June 2026 wala future ₹1,992 par hai — aaj ke Purnea daam ₹1,900 se ₹92 UPAR. Strong Buy ka signal aa raha hai. Pichle saal se 11.19% neeche hai lekin current premium bahut bullish hai.

**Iran ki Ladai ka Maize par Asar:**
Iran ki ladai (Feb 28 se shuru) ki wajah se Brent crude $109 par hai. IEA (duniya ki badi energy sanstha) ne kaha hai ki yeh 'biggest energy disruption in history' hai — 14.5 million barrels per day ka production ghat gaya hai! Sirf 20 tankers aaj Hormuz se guzre (normal 129 tha). Jab tel $100+ ho toh makka se ethanol banana bahut profitable hota hai — distillery wale bahut khareedenge.

**Brazil ka Kya Haal:**
USDA ki April 2026 WASDE (duniya ki fasal ki report) mein Brazil corn 125 MMT bataya tha. Lekin CONAB (Brazil ki apni agency) ka estimate 138.87 MMT hai — 14 MMT ka antar! May 9 ko NAYI WASDE aayegi — agar USDA ne Brazil zyada dikhaya toh global supply badhegi aur India ke daam par pressure badh sakta hai.

**INR ka kya haal:**
Indian rupaya aaj ₹95.06 per dollar chal raha hai — kamzor rupaya matlab bahar se maal mangana MEHNGA ho jaata hai. Isse India ki domestic makka thodi zyada competitive ho jaati hai bahar se saste corn ke samne.

**Agle 10 Din Ka Anumaan:**
Aaj ₹1,900 se chalu hokar May 13 tak ₹1,840 tak girne ka anumaan hai — ₹60 ki girawat. LEKIN Iran war jari raha aur NCDEX Strong Buy bana raha toh yeh girawat dheemi rahegi. Sabse important event: May 9 ko WASDE report aayegi.

**Kisan Bhai Ke Liye Clear Advice:**
Jo BECHNA chahte hain: Abhi ₹1,900 mil raha hai — is hafte ke andar bech do. Peak arrivals se daam aur girenge May 10-15 tak. Jo KHAREEDNA chahte hain (murgi-wale, factory-wale): May 9-13 tak ruko — ₹1,840-1,860 mein milega. WASDE ke baad decision karo.

news_items.title: Iran ki ladai jari hai — Trump ka 'Project Freedom' naakaam raha, Brent $109.60 upar, Hormuz mein tanker par hamla hua aaj
news_items.category: Geopolitics / Iran War — Crude Oil Ethanol Demand
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** Aaj May 4 ko Al Jazeera (badi news agency) ne bataya ki America ke President Trump ne 'Project Freedom' plan diya Strait of Hormuz (ek zaroori samandar ka rasta jahan se duniya ka 20% tel guzarta tha) kholne ke liye. Lekin Iran ke parliament leaders ne kaha ki koi bhi American dakhal (interference) ceasefire todna maana jaayega. Aur aaj hi UK military ne bataya ki ek tanker par UAE ke paas 'unknown projectiles' (anjaan missiles ya explosives) ka hamla hua.

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Strait of Hormuz (ek tange samandar ka rasta jaise ek gali mein sabse zaroori darvaza) band rehne se Goldman Sachs ke mutabik 14.5 million barrels per day ka global oil production ghat gaya hai! Sirf 20 tankers kal wahan se guzre, aam taur par 129 guzarte the. IEA (duniya ki badi energy sanstha) ne kaha ki yeh 'biggest energy disruption in history' hai. Brent crude $109.60 par hai (+1.32% aaj). Jab tel $100+ hota hai toh makka se ethanol (petrol mein milane wali sharab) banana bahut profitable ho jaata hai — distillery wale bahut zyada makka khareedenge.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Tel $109 par rehna makka ke liye ek bada support hai. Ethanol factories max capacity par chal rahi hain. Distillery wale makka zyada khareedenge. Isse Purnea mandi mein ₹10-15 per quintal ka support milta hai.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Abhi ₹1,900 milta hai — acha daam hai geopolitical support ki wajah se. Becho, mat ruko.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Iran war se ethanol demand bahut zyada hai — daam jyada girenge nahi. May 9-10 ke baad kharido.

news_items.title: Brazil corn — USDA 125 MMT vs CONAB 138.87 MMT ka bada antar — May 9 ko NAYI WASDE report aayegi — India mein asar hoga
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** America ki sarkar ki April 9 WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — duniya ki sabse badi fasal report jo hath mahine ek baar aati hai) mein Brazil ka corn 125 MMT (Million Metric Tonne — lakhon tonne) bataya. Lekin CONAB (Brazil ki apni sarkari agency — wahan ka USDA) ka estimate 138.87 MMT hai — poore 14 MMT ka antar! May 9 ko NAYI WASDE report aayegi — sirf 5 din baad!

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** WASDE matlab ek bahut badi global fasal report — jaise India ka NSSO survey lekin pure duniya ke liye. 138.87 MMT vs 125 MMT — agar USDA ne apna estimate badhaya toh duniya mein zyada makka hai — jo global daam ke liye bearish (daam girane wala) hai. Ek zaroori baat: Iran ki ladai ke karan Brazil ka Iran ko 9+ MMT corn ka export ruk gaya hai — toh Brazil ke paas zyada makka bacha hua hai jo kisi aur ko milega. Yeh India ke import pressure ke liye bearish hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Agar May 9 ki WASDE mein Brazil zyada dikhaya — toh global corn prices girenge aur India mein bhi ₹10-20 per quintal additional pressure aa sakta hai. Yeh ek important risk hai agle 5 din mein.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: May 9 se pehle bech do — WASDE ke baad daam aur gir sakte hain agar Brazil zyada dikhaya.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: May 9 ke baad kharido — WASDE ke baad scene zyada clear hoga. Thoda wait karo.

news_items.title: MSP se ₹500 ka seedha nuksan — sarkar ka tay kiya ₹2,400 ka daam aaj bhi door hai — October 2025 se leke 7 mahine se yahi haal

news_items.explanation:

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** MSP woh daam hai jo sarkar kehti hai ki is se kam mein nahi bikni chahiye — jaise ek promise. Lekin aaj mandi mein sirf ₹1,900 milta hai — ₹500 per quintal NEECHE MSP se! Matlab aise samjho: aap ek kilo makka ugaate ho jisme ₹24 lagte hain, lekin bechne par sirf ₹19 milta hai — ₹5 ka seedha ghata! Sarkar khud koi procurement (kharidi) nahi kar rahi. October 2025 se lekar aaj May 2026 tak — poore 7 mahine se — bazaar MSP ke NEECHE chal raha hai. Ek bora (50 kilo) mein ₹250 ka nuksan ho raha hai kisan bhai ko.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Yeh structural problem hai — sarkar ke bina kharidi ke daam upar jaana mushkil hai. Lekin NCDEX ka ₹1,992 ka daam batata hai ki private distillery aur poultry wale dheere dheere MSP ke taraf daam laane lage hain Iran war ki wajah se.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Sarkar procurement ka intezaar mat karo — woh hoga nahi. Jo milta hai ₹1,900, abhi bech do. Is hafte ke andar becho.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Daam MSP se bahut neeche hain — acha kharidi ka mauka hai is mahine.

news_items.title: IMD Bihar — May 2026 mein above-normal baarish, temperature neeche, pre-monsoon activity — arrivals thodi delayed ho sakti hain
news_items.category: IMD Weather Bihar — Rabi Harvest Impact
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka sarkari mausam vibhag, jaise TV par aagrahi mausam ki poori jaankari deta hai) ke Patna Meteorological Centre ne May 2026 ke liye kaha hai ki Bihar mein is mahine ABOVE-NORMAL (zyada) baarish hogi aur temperature BELOW-NORMAL (thanda) rahega. April mein average maximum temperature 39.8 degree tha — bahut garmi. Gaya mein aaj 45 degree Celsius record hua (May 4 ki Patna Press khabar se).

**MATLAB KYA HAI:** Zyada baarish aur thanda mausam matlab: (1) khet mein makka thodi dheere sukhegi aur mandi mein aana thoda dheema padega — isse arrivals peak thoda peeche khisak sakta hai, (2) aaj Gaya mein 45 degree temperature — bahut garmi se poultry ki demand bhi kuch affect hoti hai. Weather event = arrivals mein thodi delay = daam ka support milta hai thodi deri ke liye.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Baarish se kuch din mandi mein maal aana ruk jaata hai — woh dino mein daam thoda flat ya thoda upar jaata hai. Lekin yeh chhoti temporary effect hai — peak arrivals pressure aaj bhi jari hai.

**AAPKO KYA KARNA CHAHIYE:**
- Agar BECHNE wale hain: Baarish hone se mat ruko — geeli makka mandi mein nahi bik sakti. Sukha maal aaj hi le jaao.
- Agar KHAREEDNE wale hain: Baarish se arrivals thodi delay hongi — May 10-12 tak wait karo saste rate ke liye.

news_items.title: E20 niyam 34 din se lagu hai — distillery ki steady structural demand ab normal ho gayi, ethanol production March mein pichle saal se 4.76% zyada
news_items.category: E20 Mandate — Post-Mandate Structural Ethanol Demand
news_items.explanation:
**KYA HUA:** E20 ka niyam (sarkar ka rule ki petrol mein 20% ethanol — makka se banane wali sharab — milana LAZMI hai) 1 April 2026 se lagu hua — aaj 34 din ho gaye. USDA ke May 1 ke data ke mutabik America mein March 2026 mein corn se banai ethanol ka use 474.4 million bushels tha — pichle saal se 4.76% ZYADA! **MATLAB KYA HAI:** E20 mandate ka matlab hai ki ab permanently petrol mein 20% ethanol (makka se bani sharab) milani padegi — ek permanent naya khareedaar ban gaya hai makka ka. India mein makka se total ethanol ka 45.68% hissa banta hai. AIDA (All India Distillers Association — distillery walon ki sanstha) ke March 24 ke conclave mein E30 (30% ethanol) ki bhi maang ki gayi thi. Yeh long-term ke liye makka ke liye bahut achhi baat hai.

**AAPKI FASAL PAR ASAR:** Distillery wale ab regular schedule par khareed rahe hain — na jaldi na dheere. Iran war ke chalte crude $109 par hai toh E30 ki taraf bhagane ka pressure bhi hai. Permanent demand floor ban gaya hai makka ka. ₹10-15 per quintal ka support milta hai is se.

Yeh demand hamesha rahegi — murgi-wale hamesha khareedenge. DDGS (bahar se sasta murgi-chaara) abhi bhi nahi aa raha kyunki FSSAI (khaane ki safety sanstha) ka GM-barrier wahi hai. Matlab murgi-walon ka makka kharidna jari rahega. Iran war ke karan LPG bhi mehnga hua hai — isse poultry ki cost badhi hai lekin demand bhi badi hai kyunki log murgi zyada khaane lage hain.
neutral: IMD (India Meteorological Department — India ka mausam vibhag) ne May 2026 ke liye kaha ki Bihar mein above-normal baarish hogi aur temperature below-normal rahega. April mein bahut garmi thi (39.8 degree average, 44.4 degree peak). Baarish se kuch din arrivals dheemi hoti hain (geeli makka nahi bik sakti) — thoda daam support milta hai. Lekin jab baarish rukti hai toh ek saath bahut maal aata hai — jo daam ke liye bura hai. Net effect: neutral — ek side balance dusri.

May 9, 2026 ko USDA ki monthly WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — duniya ki sabse badi fasal report) aayegi. Pichle WASDE (April 9) mein global coarse grain production 5.1 MMT upar gaya tha. Agar May WASDE mein Brazil zyada dikhaya (CONAB ke karib 138 MMT) toh bearish. Agar Brazil mein safrinha (doosri season ki fasal) ki koi problem batai toh bullish. Abhi uncertain hai — ek 2-way risk event hai. Kisan bhai: May 9 se pehle becho — yeh event risk hai.

metadata.key_risks_to_watch: Kisan bhai — agle 10 din in 5 baton par dhyan rakhna: (1) May 9 WASDE report — agar USDA ne Brazil ki paidawar 138 MMT ke karib dikhaya (CONAB ke barabar) toh global corn supply zyada dikhegi aur India mein bhi ₹15-25 per quintal aur girne ka risk hai — is se pehle becho. (2) Iran war ki situation — agar Trump-Iran ceasefire pakka ho gaya aur Hormuz khul gaya toh Brent crude gir sakta hai $80-90 tak — jis se ethanol demand thodi kam hogi aur makka ka support kamzor padega. (3) Bihar rabi arrivals ka peak (May 5-15) — jab sabse zyada maal aayega mandi mein tab daam sabse tez girenge — is window se pehle becho. (4) FSSAI ka GM-DDGS faisla — agar FSSAI ne American murgi-chaara (DDGS) ko GM-free certificate de diya toh murgi-wale maize kam khareedenge — seedha demand loss. (5) INR/USD rate — aaj ₹95.06 par hai — agar aur kamzor hua toh bahar ka maal aur mehnga hoga, jo India ka daam support karega.
